realtime_scanning_enabled.title: Real-Time On-Access Scanning Enabled
realtime_scanning_enabled.description: Whether continuous on-access scanning is actively enabled and enforced by policy on the endpoint

detection_engines_active.title: Active Detection Engine Types
detection_engines_active.description: List of detection engine types currently active on the endpoint (e.g., signature, heuristic, behavioral)

signature_definition_age_days.title: Signature Definition Age (Days)
signature_definition_age_days.description: Number of days since the malware signature definitions were last successfully updated on the endpoint

policy_tamper_protection_enabled.title: Tamper Protection Enabled
policy_tamper_protection_enabled.description: Whether tamper protection is enabled to prevent unauthorized disabling or modification of the endpoint protection agent and its settings

baseline_framework.title: Configuration Baseline Framework
baseline_framework.description: The security baseline framework applied to enforce hardened configuration on workstations

enforcement_mode.title: Baseline Enforcement Mode
enforcement_mode.description: Whether the baseline policy is in active enforcement mode (blocking unauthorized changes) or only in audit/reporting mode

compliance_percentage.title: Baseline Compliance Percentage
compliance_percentage.description: The percentage of baseline controls currently in compliant state across managed endpoints

drift_detection_enabled.title: Configuration Drift Detection Enabled
drift_detection_enabled.description: Whether automated detection and alerting on configuration drift from the baseline is active

behavioral_protection_enabled.title: Behavioral Protection Enabled
behavioral_protection_enabled.description: Indicates whether the endpoint agent's behavioral execution prevention module is actively enabled and enforcing policy, covering code injection, privilege escalation, and fileless attack detection.

prevention_mode.title: Prevention Enforcement Mode
prevention_mode.description: The operational mode of the behavioral prevention engine and endpoint protection policy governing whether actions are actively blocked or only alerted/logged.

protection_capabilities.title: Active Behavioral Protection Capabilities
protection_capabilities.description: List of specific behavioral protection capabilities that are enabled on the endpoint, such as code injection prevention, privilege escalation blocking, and fileless execution detection.

automated_response_enabled.title: Automated Threat Response Enabled
automated_response_enabled.description: Indicates whether the endpoint protection platform is configured to automatically execute containment actions (process termination, file quarantine, network isolation) upon threat detection without requiring manual approval.

response_actions_configured.title: Configured Automated Response Actions
response_actions_configured.description: List of automated containment actions configured and active in the endpoint protection policy (e.g., 'process_termination', 'file_quarantine', 'network_isolation').

allowlist_enforcement_enabled.title: Allowlist Enforcement Enabled
allowlist_enforcement_enabled.description: Whether application control allowlist enforcement is actively enabled and enforcing (not in audit/monitor-only mode)

enforcement_scope.title: Allowlist Enforcement Scope
enforcement_scope.description: The breadth of file types and execution contexts covered by the allowlist policy

policy_applies_to_standard_users.title: Policy Applies to Standard Users
policy_applies_to_standard_users.description: Whether the allowlist policy applies to standard (non-administrator) user accounts on the workstation

telemetry_logging_enabled.title: Telemetry and Logging Enabled
telemetry_logging_enabled.description: Indicates whether comprehensive endpoint telemetry collection (process creation, file operations, registry changes, network connections) is actively enabled on the endpoint protection agent.

telemetry_event_types_covered.title: Telemetry Event Types Covered
telemetry_event_types_covered.description: List of endpoint event categories actively collected and logged. Expected values include process_creation, file_operations, registry_changes, network_connections.

siem_integration_status.title: SIEM Integration Status
siem_integration_status.description: Operational status of the endpoint telemetry forwarding integration with a SIEM or centralized log management platform, encompassing both forwarding enablement and EDR API connectivity.

edr_api_integration_status.title: EDR API Integration Status
edr_api_integration_status.description: The connectivity and operational status of the API integration between the endpoint protection platform and the EDR/XDR platform

alert_enrichment_configured.title: Alert Enrichment Configured
alert_enrichment_configured.description: Whether endpoint alerts forwarded to SIEM are enriched with contextual metadata (e.g., asset owner, hostname, threat intelligence tags) for correlated detection

signature_update_enabled.title: Signature Auto-Update Enabled
signature_update_enabled.description: Indicates whether automatic signature/definition updates are enabled and the update source is reachable on the endpoint protection platform

signature_age_hours.title: Signature Age in Hours
signature_age_hours.description: Number of hours since the last successful signature/definition update was applied to the workstation

update_source_reachable.title: Update Source Reachable
update_source_reachable.description: Indicates whether the workstation can successfully reach its configured signature update source (vendor cloud, WSUS, or internal mirror)

centralized_console_enabled.title: Centralized Management Console Enabled
centralized_console_enabled.description: Whether the endpoint protection centralized management console is active and agents are enrolled/reporting to it

policy_deployment_status.title: Policy Deployment Status
policy_deployment_status.description: Current state of policy distribution from the management console to managed endpoints

unhealthy_agent_percentage.title: Unhealthy Agent Percentage
unhealthy_agent_percentage.description: Percentage of enrolled workstation agents reporting as unhealthy, offline, or out-of-policy in the management console
